Within Architecture & Application Portfolio Management, you shape the evolution of our Enterprise Architecture at Group level. At the core is the development of an effective Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) practice in LeanIX — as the foundation for reliable transparency across business processes, applications, data and technologies.
How do you make sure your architecture expertise doesn't stay conceptual, but leads to target pictures and solution options that genuinely work in everyday business? A team driving architecture across domain boundaries is looking forward to supporting well-founded decisions and advancing our IT landscape together with you.

TASKS WITH IMPACT

- You build up Enterprise Architecture Management and LeanIX as the central architecture repository, establish it, and continuously develop the metamodel, fact sheets, roles and governance processes further.
- You create transparency across the IT landscape by structuring, documenting and making usable business processes, business capabilities, applications, data, technologies, interfaces and dependencies.
- You establish data quality standards and clear responsibilities, actively address data gaps, and position LeanIX as a reliable basis for decision-making in day-to-day business.
- You drive stakeholder enablement together with business functions and IT, run trainings, roadshows and reviews, and embed architecture processes sustainably into everyday work.
- You accompany selected architecture topics and business domains independently — from analysing the current landscape to developing target pictures, evaluating options, and preparing architecture sketches and impact assessments for business functions and IT.
- You further develop reusable architecture principles, standards and guardrails, and identify potential for standardisation and rationalisation.
- You assess new requirements and technologies for their impact on the enterprise architecture, prioritise them, and translate them into concrete architecture measures.

YOUR SKILLS

- You bring several years of experience in enterprise architecture and complex IT landscapes.
- Very good practical knowledge of LeanIX or comparable EAM tools, together with experience in target architectures, portfolio management and transformation processes, sets you apart; experience in a retail environment is a plus.
- Strategic thinking allows you to translate the overall architecture into clear target pictures and development options.
- Structured, traceable documentation of complex interrelations in LeanIX is a natural part of your way of working.
- Building sustainable relationships with business departments and IT is part of your day-to-day work, and you actively foster exchange within the architecture community.
- In daily operations, you embed architecture processes in a hands-on way and ensure they are used sustainably.
- Driving the ongoing development of the IT landscape, you identify synergies as well as standardization and rationalization potential.
- Whether with internal or international stakeholders, you communicate confidently in English and German in a business context.

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Join the dynamic Internal Consulting team at Boehringer Ingelheim! We're looking for innovative thinkers who are ready to shape our company's future.
As a Manager Consulting, you'll design, execute, and steer strategic initiatives within Boehringer Ingelheim. You'll independently coordinate project tasks, run data analyses, develop hypotheses and strategize solutions.
We value work-life balance, offering flexible work models and a location at the Headquarters in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main area.
This position is part time eligible with min. 80%.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As Manager Consulting, you will support in the design, execution and steering of strategic initiatives across businesses, functions, therapeutic areas, and regions within Boehringer Ingelheim.
- You will independently drive work packages within projects, generating strategic insights to enable informed decisions of top-level leaders.
- With your experience, you will run data analyses, develop hypotheses, find possible strategic paths and create actionable solutions to advance the organization.
- Having the successful outcome always in mind, you will track the progress and strategic alignment of projects and initiatives, in close collaboration with our business partners.

Requirements

- Excellent master's degree in sciences, economics or engineering (PhD or MBA a plus)
- Several years' experience with top-tier management consultancy, preferably with a focus on Pharma
- Track record of working on diverse national and international strategic projects
- Excellent critical thinking and analytical skills, with high attention to detail
- Great team player, with strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills
- C1 level English (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

You are at home in international B2B sales, think commercially and know how to turn complex customer requirements into successful business relationships? Then join our Sales team in Leipzig.

As Senior Sales Manager, you will develop existing customer relationships, win new business and successfully position our combined Cell Testing and Module Testing portfolio in the market. You will connect customers and market needs with our teams in Leipzig and The Hague.

- Monitor market, customer and competitor developments and identify new business opportunities 
- Visit customers internationally and represent us at trade fairs, conferences and industry events, predominantly in Europe but not exclusively Europe 

Your profile

- Several years of solid international B2B sales experience at senior level 
- Experience with long and complex products and sales processes cycles 
- What matters is your strong sales background, not a technical or scientific degree 
- Strong commercial mindset and a good understanding of customer needs, business opportunities and company interests
- Proven experience in new customer acquisition, account development, pricing and commercial negotiations
- Confident communication, strong networking skills and the ability to connect with different people and interests
- Very good German and English skills
- Willingness to travel internationally for customer visits and business
- Experience in the solar industry is a plus, not a must

What we offer

- A responsible senior sales role in an international high-tech environment
- The opportunity to actively shape the growth of WAVELABS and Eternal Sun
- Direct cooperation with our Sales Director and the international Sales team
- A motivated team, short communication lines and plenty of room for initiative
- Flat hierarchies and an open, collegial working atmosphere
- Flexible working hours and a modern workplace at our Leipzig site

Who are we?

The solar industry is booming worldwide - and we are actively shaping it. WAVELABS has repositioned itself: with our new owner Eternal Sun, fresh capital and a committed team, we are back on a growth path. Our high-precision measurement systems help research institutes and manufacturers around the world develop and produce solar cells more efficiently and cost-effectively. Together, we are writing the next chapter of WAVELABS - and we are looking for people who want to shape this journey with curiosity, initiative and enthusiasm.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer (f/m/d) - Life Science and Diagnostics (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)
jobs.description:
Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About the opportunity

In the position of an AI Engineer (f/m/d) you will work with our system and software teams to develop instrument control and data analysis software for laboratory devices helping our customers to get valuable insights from a biological sample. You use your expertise building real-world AI agent systems to work in an environment where AI agents support the development of medical-grade software. In this role you will set the blueprint for AI-enabled software engineering across QIAGEN, changing how our developers, testers, architects and DevOps engineers work every day.

Your tasks include

* Design and build multi-agent workflows that automate software development lifecycle processes, from planning and design through implementation, testing and documentation.
* Translate the knowledge of our teams, including architecture decisions, domain models and business rules, into reusable, machine-readable building blocks that AI agents can work with reliably.
* Build evaluation loops that measure the quality and correctness of AI-generated outputs against the standards of a regulated environment, and continuously improve them.
* Integrate AI agents with the tools our teams rely on every day, as well as to our instruments and software products using MCP servers, Git, CI/CD pipelines and REST APIs.
* Serve as lead AI engineer, guiding and mentoring junior engineers and colleagues across the development team in adopting agentic AI in their daily work.
* Collaborate with international development teams in Poland, Spain, and Denmark to strengthen and refine your technical capabilities and personal network.

 

Your profile

* A master's degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related discipline
* 3+ years of professional experience in software and product development, including the successful delivery of complex software solutions in agile environments
* Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language and working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines and containerization
* Experience building AI agents, agentic systems or LLM-based applications, including evaluating, testing and validating AI-generated outputs
* Hands-on experience building MCP servers or clients and integrating AI agents with other systems through APIs. Knowledge of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) that allow AI agents to monitor and operate hardware through a common interface is a plus.
* Regular use of AI-assisted development tools in your daily work, such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot
* Excellent communication skills in both English and German (C1 level)

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

What to Expect

The Bodyshop Technical Trainer position requires someone with exceptional ability to deliver learning solutions within their region. The Tesla Bodyshop Technical Trainer will take responsibility for ensuring our internal and external repair network is equipped to deliver the best ownership experience the world has ever seen for every Tesla owner. Key responsibilities include facilitating hands-on technical Onboarding and Continuous Bodyshop technical training, mentoring and supporting Bodyshop technicians, and partnering closely with local Bodyshop Managers and regional network managers to train for skill gaps and elevate the performance of their teams and regions.   This individual must be creative, proactive, organized, flexible, results-oriented, and have a passion for and understanding of electric vehicles. Must have outstanding communication, facilitation, and organizational skills while demonstrating a positive and professional demeanor.Please note that only 1 role/headscount is open, to be hired either in the UK or Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Facilitate Onboarding and Continuous instructor-led and virtual Bodyshop technical training on electric vehicles equipped with complex automotive and electromechanical systems to enable employees to perform their role safely and to Tesla’s standards
- Maintain expert knowledge of the most current product knowledge, systems, methods, techniques, and best practices of Bodyshop repair procedure and processes  
- Support the Content Development team with reviewing training material, as needed  
- Support local apprentice programs as needed, including delivering training, supporting apprentice mentors, and reviewing training materials
- Partner with Managers and Coaches to identify and train for skill gap development of employees
- Serve, coach and mentor a network of Internal Bodyshop technicians and coaches to enhance core capabilities and ensure continuous process improvement
- Support and manage any local and specific projects with minimal guidance

What You’ll Bring

- Fluency in English is a non-negotiable requirement. Dutch and German language skills would be a plus
- Strong understanding of vehicle body repair processes, including aluminum and steel welding, mechanical, electrical, trim and refinishing knowledge. Experience of electric vehicles repairs is strongly preferred
- Strong facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills required
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and demonstrated confidence and professionalism in working in a customer-facing role
- Proactive, flexible, confident, professional, and self-directed in a fast-paced environment
- Ability to travel at least 60% of the time, with a valid Driver’s License and a valid passport
- Experience with environmental and safety requirements is a plus

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.
